|game_text=“Free” on You’re A Slave? is treated as “2 Force.” Once per turn, may shuffle Reserve Deck and draw destiny. If destiny is odd, for remainder of turn your Force drains at [Episode I] sites are +1; if even, may take card drawn into hand.
